baseline_gif_profile.workload: Plus, eight labelled 120x120 keys, 100 FPS looping GIF, installed Liberation Sans
baseline_gif_profile.method: perf record -F 4999 -e cycles:u --call-graph dwarf,8192; 15-second warmup, separate 20-second profile

memory_maps.method: Fresh background Plus 100 FPS processes; /proc/PID/smaps at 15 and 30 seconds, grouped by mappings. Separate from timing.
memory_maps.finding: Both anonymous heaps are 6.35546875 MiB, stable at both snapshots. New application-image PSS +0.03125 MiB. No growing heap in this window; no multi-day leak claim.

video_profile.workload: Plus, eight labelled 120x120 keys, same 60 FPS single-pass FFV1 video
video_profile.method: Same PMU sampling, attached to the native app and its FFmpeg child together; 15-second warmup, separate 20-second capture
video_profile.finding: JPEG encoding and FFmpeg consume most sampled work; RGB packing is a small remaining share. This supports reporting the modest video change rather than promising broad speedups. Profiling overhead means these values must not replace uninstrumented trial results.
